gameName: Descent: Journeys in the Dark (Second Edition)

steps.text: Choose a quest from the Quest Guide (first game: Acolyte of Saradyn)
Campaign: start with Acolyte of Saradyn in the Act I Quest Guide
steps.ref: Campaign Rules, Quests in a Campaign

steps.text: Campaign: put the Act II Shop Items, Monster and Lieutenant cards back in the box
Build the map from the quest's Encounter 1 diagram, with its doors
Pick the overlord (the most experienced player is suggested; die roll if you disagree); everyone else plays heroes
Damage, fatigue, hero and condition tokens in piles in reach
Shuffle the Search deck facedown by the heroes; Condition cards in piles by type
Each hero player: a Reference card and the hero tokens of its colour
Agree who plays which hero; take the Hero sheet and figure
steps.note: 2 players: the hero player runs 2 heroes

steps.text: Each hero picks a Class deck matching their archetype (Warrior, Healer, Mage, Scout), no class twice; box the unused ones
Keep the basic skill (no XP icon) and starting equipment; box the other skills
Keep the basic skill and starting equipment; keep the rest of the Class deck facedown for later
steps.ref: Campaign Rules, Starting a New Campaign

steps.text: Epic Play: each hero gets {xp} XP of Class cards and {gold} gold of Shop Items (gold may be shared)
Hero figures on the quest's hero start area (usually an entrance)
Take the Act I Monster cards and figures of the monster groups chosen from the quest's options
If the quest has a lieutenant, take its Act I Lieutenant card and token
Follow the quest's Setup: monsters, objective, search and villager tokens
Shuffle the 15 basic Overlord cards as the Overlord deck (box the others)
Epic Play: the overlord gets {xp} XP of Overlord cards (Expert also uses Act II Monster and Lieutenant cards)
Draw Overlord cards equal to the number of heroes
Quest rules beat cards, and cards beat the rulebook
Campaign: heroes and classes are fixed for the whole campaign
steps.ref: Campaign Rules, Starting a New Campaign

steps.text: Heroes go first, in an order they agree each round (else clockwise from the overlord's left); then the overlord
